data.text:
spoolctl robot-docs guide

Discover the contract
- spoolctl capabilities --json
- spoolctl schema --json
- spoolctl brief --json
- spoolctl config-show --json
- spoolctl config-validate --json

Check local readiness
- spoolctl doctor --json
- doctor exits 3 with ok:true and data.ready:false for readiness failures.
- Use data.checks remediation text; doctor does not repair or mutate config.

Submit and observe work
- spoolctl add --json --key run-1 --tag owner=agent -- true
- spoolctl work --json --once
- spoolctl wait --json 1
- spoolctl output --json 1 --stream stdout

Get a verdict in one call
- spoolctl feedback --json 1
- Read terminal first, then succeeded: null succeeded means still in flight.
- data.remediation is the next command to run; data.streams carries output tails.
- Use --tail-bytes N for more output, --stream to narrow the text rendering.

Handle conflicts and safety
- Reuse --key only with the same execution payload.
- Use prune --dry-run before prune --yes.
- Use cancel --running --yes only when process interruption is intended.
- Use retry --force only for a running-job recovery override.

Stream and page safely
- spoolctl events --json --limit 100
- spoolctl events --follow --json --since-id 0 --max-events 1
- spoolctl events --follow --json --idle-timeout 0.1
- spoolctl list --json --limit 50
